hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$f" in *src/rental_ranking/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run pytest tests/ -q >&2 || exit 2; elif command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest tests/ -q >&2 || exit 2; else echo 'guardrail hook: pytest not available, skipping tests' >&2; fi;; esac
